title: The Wheels Museum

blurb: WHEELS Museum is a nonprofit organization in the Albuquerque Rail Yards dedicated to collecting, preserving, and creating educational exhibits about the history of transportation in Albuquerque and New Mexico with emphasis on the impact on the development of the area.
hoursText: open Monday - Thursday from 9 am to 12 pm
